  • Constructor Details

    • Game

      public Game(int width, int height, boolean powerUp, char difficulty)
      Creates a board with three lives and the selected base difficulty.
      Parameters:
      width - board width in cells
      height - board height in cells
      powerUp - whether the collectible sequence includes power-ups
      difficulty - E for easy, N for normal or H for hard
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if a dimension is not positive or the difficulty is unknown
